result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a '-0%' badge on the pizza card that should not be displayed.

issues.description: Discount badge on the second card under 'Popular right now' displays '-0%', which is meaningless and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when there is no discount or fix the data/logic to show the correct discount value, e.g. '-20%' or '€0 delivery'.
